description: This file defines a benchmarking class for comparing serialization performance of arrays in Orleans against other serializers. It includes setup for test data, multiple serialization methods, and benchmarking configurations. It references various external serializers like MessagePack, Protobuf, System.Text.Json, and Orleans.Serialization, and defines several benchmark methods to test serialization performance with different buffer implementations and techniques.

classes.name: ArraySerializeBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmarking class to compare Orleans serialization performance against other serializers for array types.
